title: Cargonaut openers (extension binding) — FR-207
description: Per-(ext|glob|mime) Open / View / Edit command dispatch. Loaded from ~/.config/cargonaut/openers.toml (overridable by per-dir ./.cargonaut.openers.toml). Matched in declaration order; first match wins. Macros: %f (focused active), %F (focused passive), %d (active dir), %D (passive dir), %b (basename), %x (extension), %% (literal). Every macro substitution MUST be shell-quoted by the implementation (FR-205/206/207 shell-injection rule).

match.description: Exactly one of ext, glob, or mime must be set.

ext.description: File extension WITHOUT leading dot, e.g. "png".

open.description: Command run on Enter. Falls back to view if unset.

view.description: Command run on F3 (previewer pipe-through). Output captured to previewer pane.

edit.description: Command run on F4. Falls back to $EDITOR if unset (FR-104 compat).
